sources.locator: printed p. 24, section 'Tupi do Machado' group, entry TUKUMÃFED; index entry 'Tukumãfed 24' on the last page
sources.note: The entire entry is these three lines: location (middle rio Machado), 'tribu inconnue', probably related to the preceding groups (Tupi do Machado / Takuatepe, known only from FARIA's unpublished material). No word forms, no phonology, no accent, stress or tone statement anywhere in the work for this or any language. The work is a classification of the Tupi-Guarani family by hypothetical migrations (p. 8: 'je propose une nouvelle classification des langues et dialectes de la famille Tupi-Guarani', 'les langues sont classées d'après leurs migrations hypothétiques') plus a bibliographic index; no
